Benchmark.title: Application Security and Development STIG (sample excerpt)

Rule.title: The application must limit the number of concurrent sessions to an organization-defined number.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Application management includes limiting the number of concurrent sessions; unlimited sessions raise the risk of denial of service and session abuse.</VulnDiscussion><FalsePositives></FalsePositives>
Rule.fixtext: Configure the application to limit the number of concurrent sessions per account.

check.check-content: Review the application configuration for a concurrent-session limit. If none is enforced, this is a finding.

Rule.title: The application must transmit only encrypted representations of passwords.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Passwords sent in the clear can be intercepted. All password transmission must be over an encrypted channel.</VulnDiscussion><FalsePositives></FalsePositives>
Rule.fixtext: Configure the application to transmit passwords only over TLS.

check.check-content: Capture an authentication request. If credentials are transmitted without TLS, this is a finding.

Rule.title: The application must display the Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner before granting access.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Display of the DoD-approved use notification before logon is a legal prerequisite for monitoring.</VulnDiscussion><FalsePositives></FalsePositives>
Rule.fixtext: Configure the application to present the Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner at logon.

check.check-content: Access the logon page. If the DoD consent banner is not displayed, this is a finding.

Rule.title: The application must use FIPS-validated cryptographic modules for all cryptographic operations.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Non-FIPS-validated cryptography provides no assurance of correct implementation and is prohibited for protecting DoD information.</VulnDiscussion><FalsePositives></FalsePositives>
Rule.fixtext: Configure the application to use only FIPS-validated cryptographic modules and cipher suites.

check.check-content: Enumerate the cryptographic modules/cipher suites in use. If any are not FIPS-validated, this is a finding.
